python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, json, datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
def run(args):
    return subprocess.check_output(args,text=True).strip()
def inspect():
    return json.loads(run(["docker","inspect","minecraft"]))[0]
initial=inspect()
assert initial["State"]["Running"]
mounts=[m for m in initial["Mounts"] if m["Destination"]=="/data"]
assert len(mounts)==1 and mounts[0]["Type"]=="bind" and mounts[0]["Source"]=="/opt/docker/minecraft/data"
image=initial["Image"]
print("Reset started:",datetime.datetime.now(ZoneInfo("America/New_York")).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p %Z"),flush=True)
print(run(["docker","stop","--time","120","minecraft"]),flush=True)
stopped=inspect()
assert not stopped["State"]["Running"] and stopped["State"]["ExitCode"]==0, "Server did not stop cleanly"
print("Minecraft stopped cleanly; exit code 0",flush=True)
cleanup="""set -eu
test -d /data/world
test ! -L /data/world
test -f /data/world/level.dat
grep -qx 'level-name=world' /data/server.properties
grep -qx 'level-seed=' /data/server.properties
before="$(find /data -maxdepth 1 -type f -exec sha256sum {} + | sort)"
rm -rf -- /data/world
test ! -e /data/world
after="$(find /data -maxdepth 1 -type f -exec sha256sum {} + | sort)"
test "$before" = "$after"
echo 'Old world deleted; all top-level server files unchanged'
"""
print(run(["docker","run","--rm","--pull","never","--network","none","--read-only","--user","0:0","--mount","type=bind,src=/opt/docker/minecraft/data,dst=/data","--entrypoint","sh",image,"-c",cleanup]),flush=True)
print(run(["docker","start","minecraft"]),flush=True)
print("Reset completed:",datetime.datetime.now(ZoneInfo("America/New_York")).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p %Z"),flush=True)
